title: The Stouffville Market Oktoberfest
summary: THE STOUFFVILLE MARKET OKTOBERFEST BEER GARDEN – Saturday, Oct. 11th From 11am–2pm, we’re bringing Oktoberfest to Stouffville downtown! Expect cold beer, games, music, prizes and a special beer + sausage combo with the crew from @link_haus sausages.
